tier: C (opaque-core-must-defer — the largest opaque partition in the class)
essence: A GPU-accelerated 3D renderer living inside one AE effect. The user imports/builds a 3D scene (OBJ/C4D/E3D models, materials, texture maps) in Element's separate modal 'Scene Setup' editor, assigns models to up to 5 replication 'Groups', then Element renders that scene into the layer with its own camera/lighting/shadow/AO/reflection/DOF pipeline. The 2431 effect params are a per-group particle-replicator + transform + material-tint + render/output control surface layered ON TOP of the imported scene — and they render NOTHING until a scene exists. Used for 3D logos/titles, replicated object arrays (floating shards, coins, cards), 3D-tracked scene integration.
when_to_use: GPU 3D render inside AE without a full 3D app

state_model.reasoning: The load-bearing state is NOT in scalar params: it is (1) the imported GEOMETRY (OBJ/C4D/E3D meshes + vertex/UV data), (2) the MATERIAL GRAPH (shaders, per-channel maps: diffuse/spec/gloss/normal/reflection/emissive), (3) the group→model ASSIGNMENT — all authored in the modal Scene Setup editor + linked texture/model FILES, serialized into ONE opaque `Scene Settings` CUSTOM param (VIDEOCOPILOT 3DArray-0004, value=""). The 2431 scalar params (5 isomorphic Group replicator blocks + a full render/output stack + 31 unassigned LAYER_INDEX pointers) are a rich control surface layered on top — but they are INERT until the scene exists. Opaque core + large scriptable surface ⇒ hybrid, but the surface is entirely GATED (unlike Roto, where the finishing surface works the moment a matte exists).

opaque_core: The 3D scene: imported geometry (model meshes + vertex/UV), the material graph (shaders + per-channel texture maps), and the group→model assignment. The scalar param API can neither read nor author any of it — it lives in the modal Scene Setup editor and the linked model/texture files, fronted by the empty `Scene Settings` CUSTOM blob.

scriptable_surface.controls: Per-group particle replication / array layout (the 5 identical Group N blocks — the '3DArray')
scriptable_surface.example_params: Particle Count -0117 (0..1e6), Grid X/Y/Z -0119/-0120/-0121 (1..1000), replicator shape/spacing

scriptable_surface.controls: Per-group placement & orientation of the array in 3D
scriptable_surface.example_params: Position XY -0202 (2D_SPATIAL) + Position Z -0203, Scale XYZ -0210/-02.., Rotation group

scriptable_surface.controls: Per-group deformers on the imported geometry
scriptable_surface.example_params: Deform -0000: Taper -0034, Twist -0017, Bend -0003, Noise -0073 (each animatable 1D)
Animation Engine -0050 (Directional/Radial, Dual Animation Mode -0081, Time Delay -0087)

scriptable_surface.controls: Full render look — lighting, shadow, AO, reflection, atmospheric, post
scriptable_surface.example_params: Exposure -1533, Gamma -1534, Lighting -1050, Shadows -5100 / Ray-Traced -5124, SSAO

scriptable_surface.controls: Color/material TINTS on already-assigned materials (NOT the material graph itself)

scriptable_surface.example_params: Output -1450: Z Depth -1500, World Position -1550, Multi-Pass Mixer -1600

scriptable_surface.controls: Comp-layer POINTERS for custom textures/masks/motion paths (pointer only — the texture channel binding is authored in Scene Setup)
scriptable_surface.example_params: N. Custom Layer LAYER_INDEX -0114/-0514/.., Custom Texture Maps 'Layer 1..10' -1852..-1861

product_can.cap: Once a scene is loaded: drive the entire array/replication look feeling→param (Particle Count, Grid, spacing, replicator shape)
Place/orient each group in 3D (Position XY+Z, Scale, Rotation); apply + animate deformers (Taper/Twist/Bend/Noise) + Scatter for organic variation
Dial the render mood: exposure/gamma/tint, lighting, shadow softness, SSAO/RTAO, reflection, DOF, glow/fog
Re-tint already-assigned materials via the 11 COLOR params; drive Animation Engine for reveal/build animations
Point a Custom Layer/Texture param at a comp layer AFTER the user has bound that channel in Scene Setup

product_must_defer.task: Create/populate the 3D scene — import or build the geometry the whole effect renders (the 2431 params are inert until this exists)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: In the effect header click 'Scene Setup' to open Element's modal editor; import your OBJ/C4D/E3D model(s) (File > Import, or drag in), or use Element's extrude/text if that's the goal; click OK.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Detect the now-non-empty scene, and drive Particle Count / Grid / Position / render-look on it.

product_must_defer.task: Assign which imported model each of the 5 Groups replicates (the group→model mapping is opaque; no scriptable hook)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: In Scene Setup, drag each model into the Group Folder (Group 1..5) you want it in.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Enable those Groups (N. Enable) and independently replicate/animate each group's model via its scriptable block.

product_must_defer.task: Author or edit the material graph — shaders + per-channel maps (diffuse/normal/reflection/gloss/emissive)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: In Scene Setup switch to the Materials panel, create/edit the material, and drop your texture image files onto the channels.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Modulate the look via the COLOR tint params + reflection/AO/glow render controls (but not the shader/maps themselves).

product_must_defer.task: Bind a live comp layer as a texture/decal/displacement source (needs a matching Custom Texture channel set in Scene Setup)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: In Scene Setup, on the target material set a channel's texture to 'Custom Texture 1..5' (or Custom Layer), click OK.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Set the corresponding 'N. Custom Layer' / 'Layer N' LAYER_INDEX param to that comp layer and animate it.

perception_signal.identify: matchName 'VIDEOCOPILOT 3DArray' + the fingerprint: exactly one CUSTOM `Scene Settings` param (VIDEOCOPILOT 3DArray-0004) fronting a very large (~2431-param), highly repetitive tree — 5 isomorphic 'Group N' replicator blocks + a full render/output stack.
perception_signal.state_present_when: There is no scriptable read of scene emptiness (the CUSTOM blob is opaque). Practical tells: a rendered frame shows geometry (visual loop), OR the artist confirms a scene is loaded. Treat as unverified until confirmed — like Roto, ASK rather than assume.
perception_signal.state_absent_when: Freshly-applied Element with `Scene Settings` = "" and no rendered geometry (the layer renders empty/transparent). All 2431 params are present but inert.

state_gate.predicate: Does the effect have a non-empty scene (imported geometry assigned to at least one Group)?
state_gate.on_absent: Do NOT set replication/render params as if they'd do anything — they're inert. Issue handoff #1 (Scene Setup → import + assign to a Group).
state_gate.on_present: Automate the replication + placement + render-look surface to the requested look; re-tint materials; drive the Animation Engine.

config_recipes.floating shard/coin array: after scene load: Group 1 Particle Count 40-200, Grid or Scatter for spread, Position-Noise + Rotation-per-particle for organic tumble, add Bend/Twist deform lightly
config_recipes.3D title reveal: extruded text scene → Animation Engine Directional + Time Delay for a per-character build; Reflection + a soft key light + SSAO for depth
config_recipes.polished-metal look: Reflection on + an environment map (Scene Setup), high gloss, SSAO subtle, exposure to taste, Color Tint for hue

reasoning_hooks.nothing renders / layer is empty: no scene loaded — the whole effect is inert; issue the Scene Setup import handoff before ANY param means something
reasoning_hooks.params set but the object doesn't change: the target Group has no model assigned, or isn't Enabled — that assignment is opaque (Scene Setup), defer it
reasoning_hooks.want more/denser copies: Particle Count + Grid on the group (replication IS scriptable once a model is assigned)
reasoning_hooks.material looks wrong / want a different: the material graph is opaque — re-tint via COLOR params for hue, but a real texture/shader change is a Scene Setup handoff

grounding: introspect card (cards/VIDEOCOPILOT_3DArray.json — 2431 params, 1601 animatable, 1 CUSTOM `Scene Settings`) + state-model analysis (spatial-ml-state-model workflow, 2026-07-19) + model prior on Element 3D. HIGH confidence on the state-model + gate + the external-authoring handoffs; the specific scriptable matchNames are sampled from the huge tree (confirm against the introspect card before setting). Teaching value: the Tier-C stress test — validates the spatial-ml schema against a 2431-param third-party monster where the ENTIRE scriptable surface is gated behind a modal + linked-file handoff (`external-authoring`), the extreme opposite of Bezier Warp.
